common.title: G2M — Dark desktop control for GTA mod stacks

hero.title: One-stop GTA Mod manager
hero.description: From archive import to prerequisite checks to launch-ready confirmation, G2M keeps the whole flow readable so people do not have to dig through folders and repeat the same checks by hand.

workflow.title: From workspace builder to game launch, finally get your mod flow under control
workflow.description: This covers what G2M actually does: workspace builder, directory mapping, prerequisite checks, conflict detection, one-click launch.

workspace.label: Workspace Builder
workspace.title: Assemble a clear workspace with GTA game dirs, mod sources, and prerequisite libraries
workspace.description: G2M detects your GTA III/VC/SA installations. You can drag in ZIPs or link existing mod folders, no manual copy-pasting required.
points: Drag-and-drop ZIP import or select local mod folders

mapping.label: Directory Mapping & Checks
mapping.title: See at a glance where each mod goes and whether prerequisites are missing
mapping.description: G2M parses common mod structures, auto-matches target directories, and scans for dependencies like ASI Loader, CLEO, SilentPatch.
points: Recognizes Cleo, Scripts, Models, Data, Text and other typical folders
Highlights missing prerequisites in red with fix suggestions
Shows exactly which files will be added or overwritten

conflict.label: Conflict Scanner
conflict.title: Catch file conflicts between mods before launching the game
conflict.description: No more CTDs after you get in-game. G2M lists where multiple mods touch the same file and lets you decide which one to use.
points: Scans file paths across all enabled mods
Highlights conflicts and lists which mods are involved
Let you choose “overwrite” or “keep existing” per conflict
